cast.characterName: ラインハルト・トリスタン・オイゲン・ハイドリヒ
cast.originalCharacterName: ラインハルト・トリスタン・オイゲン・ハイドリヒ

segments.text: The leader of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden. Originally a high-ranking official in Germany, regarded as highly dangerous due to his seemingly boundless talent in all fields. Later, he bowed out of the public eye through the guise of a staged assassination, and formed the Obsidian Round Table alongside Mercurius.

Their subordinate members acted behind the scenes of WW2 and kept on destroying friend and foe alike. His acts of destruction reached their climax during the fall of Berlin. However, he and his three direct subordinates disappeared shortly afterwards, leaving their current whereabouts a mystery.
"You would do well not to disappoint me."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page
聖槍十三騎士団黒円卓第一位“愛すべからざる光（メフィスト・フェレス）”。
黄金の獣と呼ばれるナチスドイツの高官だったが、あまりに有能すぎたために危険視されるようになる。
後、彼は自身が暗殺されたと偽装して闇に潜り、副首領と共に騎士団を結成。
配下の団員達を戦争の裏で暗躍させ、敵といわず味方といわず滅ぼし続け、壊し続ける。
彼の破壊工作はベルリン陥落時に頂点を迎えるが、その後は直属の部下3名と共に消息を絶ち、現在に至るも行方不明。
彼が戻ってきた時に、世界は破滅すると言われている。
圣枪十三骑士団的首领。
本来是德意志的高官，因为过于有才能而被处处提防。
之后，他以被暗杀作为掩护躲了起来，与メルクリウス一起建立了骑士团。
麾下的团员们暗中在战争中活跃，不论敌友一律歼灭破坏。
他的破坏工作在柏林沦陷时迎来顶峰，之后与直属部下3名一起失去了消息，直到现在依旧行踪不明。
称号：愛すべからざる光
黒円卓：一位
ルーン：破壊
大アルカナ：皇帝
占星術：白羊宮

A man with a long criminal record who served as a First Lieutenant for the infamous 36th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS. An albino, he shuns all light, especially that of the sun. In return, all of his senses magnify in the darkness, almost as if he was a vampire. Having embraced that nature of his as part of his identity. Wilhelm's designation and fondness for vampiric characteristics is no coincidence.
"State your name, kid. Don't you know anything about proper manners on the battlefield?"
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page
聖槍十三騎士団黒円卓第四位、カズィクル・ベイの異名を持つ男。
第二次大戦中から一切歳を取らずに存在し続けており、世界中の紛争地帯に現れては暴虐の限りを尽くす吸血鬼として戦場の伝説となっている。
そして現在、長年待ち続けた黄金練成という儀式のために日本へ向かう直前の彼は、接触してきたインタビュアーに己の過去を語り始める。
拥有犯罪者的经历，恶名远扬的隶属于第38SS的武装擲弾兵師団的原中尉。
白化病患者，对光线尤其阳光很是避忌。
反过来，所有感觉器官会在夜间得到加强的吸血鬼体质。
本人也引以为豪，甚至连称号也明显带有吸血鬼的属性。（“穿刺公”是著名的吸血鬼“德古拉伯爵”的原型——弗拉德三世·采佩什的称号。）
称号：串刺し公
黒円卓：四位
ルーン：茨棘
大アルカナ：戦車
占星術：巨蟹宮
形態：人器融合型
位階：創造
聖遺物：闇の賜物

segments.text: Helga Ehrenburg is the deceased mother and half sister of Wilhelm.
ヴィルヘルムの母であり、姉である女性。すでに故人だが、彼の価値観に深い影響を与えた存在のため、聖遺物『闇の賜物』がヘルガの姿を真似、ヴィルヘルムの内界に巣食っている。
ゆえにあくまで彼が認識している母かつ姉という像にすぎないが、彼女が抱く愛は本物。持てる全能力をヴィルヘルムのために捧げると誓っている。
ヴィルヘルムの母であり、姉である女性。すでに故人だが、彼の価値観に深い影響を与えた存在のため、聖遺物『闇の賜物』がヘルガの姿を真似、ヴィルヘルムの内界に巣食っている。
ゆえにあくまで彼が認識している母かつ姉という像にすぎないが、彼女が抱く愛は本物。持てる全能力をヴィルヘルムのために捧げると誓っている。

A cheerful man, who arrived from the countryside by Mikado Ryuumei directive. He appeared in the middle of the Fencing Kagura ceremony after it was disturbed by Koga Rindou Suzuka, and became her loyal vassal. He has fallen in love with her and has become ready to die for her. Yet she retorted and said that his life was not only his own, and so he should not die so lightly.
His true desire is to "live". He desired to live more than anyone else.

In the beginning, he had no name. He had neither hands, nor legs, nor even eyes, nose, or ears. His true form was a teratoma in Hajun's body. He was an unneeded being, one that would be gotten rid of if found. So he tried to hide as hard as he could, covering himself in fear.
Because his host was Hajun, the power of Shinza flowed into him. He felt danger of being found, so "Sakagami Habaki" was created.
"Sakagami Habaki" was only his mental image, that he brought to the world.
【神世創生篇 主人公】
士族としてもっとも古い血統を持つ家の出だが、先祖が過去の東征で高濃度の汚染を受けたため迫害され、今では凋落しきっている。
とはいえ、本人はそんなことを一切意に介していない自由人で、無頼かつ放埓で好色な傾奇者。
要するに、ただの馬鹿スケベである。
竜胆に一目惚れし、彼女を自分のものにするため東征への参加を決意。
仲間たちからは馬鹿の一言で認識されているが、どんな苦境にも笑みを失わない天性の明るさで、彼らの中心となっていく。
「惚れたぜ、久雅の姫さん。あんたのために俺は死のう」
出身拥有最为古老的士族血统的家族。可惜这一家族因为先祖在过去的东征时受到高浓度的污染而受到迫害，现在已经家道衰弱至极了。
话虽如此，本人则是一个完全不在意这些的自由人，一个无赖、放肆而且好色的倾奇者。总而言之，就是个笨蛋色鬼罢了。
对竜胆一见钟情，为了得到她而决定参加东征。
虽然伙伴们都用“笨蛋”这一个词概括他，但他那无论面对什么困苦也能保持笑容的开朗天性，使他逐渐成了同伴们的核心。
“我爱上你了哦，龙胆公主。我愿为你赴死。”

A lone wolf lacking in sociality. He may appear rather mature for his age, but is fast to lose his cool when complimented over his effeminate features - a trait that became somewhat of a complex for him. While normally agreeable with others, he draws a clear line between himself and the rest of his schoolmates, with the exception of a few close friends.

Unfortunately, about two months prior, a brutal fight inexplicably broke out between him and Shirou Yusa - his best friend - that left both of them hospitalized, placing Ren's already fickle reputation at school in complete jeopardy.
"If you could just get back whatever you've lost right away, wouldn't that make it worthless to begin with?"
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

Ren's upperclassman. Just as popular as Kasumi. But while Kasumi's popularity can be categorized as more or less conventional, Rea is idolized by those of more peculiar tastes, as - just like Ren - she normally tends to keep her distance from those around her.

She exudes an aura of aloofness, her well-ordered features of mixed German and Japanese blood rarely betraying emotion. However, despite that initial impression, she is hardly the type to be cold to others. An "eccentric weirdo" might be a more apt way to describe her, all things considered. Incidentally, her home is also a church.
"Don't you think God can be more than a little cruel sometimes? I'll make sure to throw Him a sucker punch for you next time I see Him."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

Tubal Cain is one of the members of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat II of the Black Round Table. Unlike most members of the Longinus Thirteen, Tubal Cain is a walking corpse with no apparent will of its own, puppeteered into combat by Riza Brenner through the use of her Ahnenerbe, Pallida Mors. It is the strongest asset in the hands of the Obsedian Round Table, only surpassed by the higher echelons of their organization.

segments.text: Valerian Trifa is a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying the third seat of the Obsedian Round Table. A catholic priest, he acts as Reinhard's representative and as the temporary leader of the LDO.

The descendant of a bloodline that allied with the Obsidian Round Table during World War II. She joined the Table to fill the spot left by a member who died eleven years prior. Furthermore, as her age - contrary to the other members - does actually match her appearance, she is too young to have met the five highest-ranking members of the Table.
"I don't need the kind of miracle one could buy with tears."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

cast.characterName: ゲッツ・フォン・ベルリッヒンゲン
cast.originalCharacterName: ゲッツ・フォン・ベルリッヒンゲン

segments.text: Iron Hand: Goëtz von Berlichingen is a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat VII. An enigmatic man, with a past veiled in mystery and an equally mysterious relationship with Ren Fujii. He is also one of the Three Knights, one of three members of the Black Round Table awarded the honor of becoming an Einherjar under Reinhard Heydrich's command, serving as part of the commanding echelons of the Longinus Thirteen and an essential piece to the success of their goals.

cast.characterName: ルサルカ・シュヴェーゲリン
cast.originalCharacterName: ルサルカ・シュヴェーゲリン

segments.text: An early member of the Deutsches Ahnenerbe - Nazi Germany's institute of archaeological and occult research - and a genuine witch who had stepped into the realm of sorcery even before joining the LDO. Her youthful appearance shelters one of the most ancient souls to have sworn loyalty to the Obsidian Round Table.

Despite being cunning and crafty at her core, she is playful and flirtatious on the outside, making her a very dangerous individual to associate with. She also has a fondness for torture and is known to be extremely moody. Though essentially not a fighter, her cruelty rivals even Wilhelm's.
"Keep underestimating me and I just might gobble you up."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

cast.characterName: エレオノーレ・フォン・ヴィッテンブルグ
cast.originalCharacterName: エレオノーレ・フォン・ヴィッテンブルグ

segments.text: Eleonore von Wittenburg is a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat IX in the Black Round Table. As the most loyal and closest underling to Reinhard, she will go on to become an Einherjar and one of the Three Knights, part of the leading echelons of the Longinus Thirteen, and an essential player in the completion of the Transmutation of Gold.

Rot Spinne is a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden. He occupies the seat number X in the Black Round Table. Mostly known by his Demon Name, as even he does not remember his true name, Spinne's nature is quite different to that of his peers. Instead of direct combat, he specializes in information gathering, black ops, and management. However, given this specialization, he is easily the most cowardly amongst the Longinus Thirteen's ranks.

actors.name: はらさわ晃綺(原沢勝広)

segments.text: Riza Brenner is the nun that is in charge of running Suwahara City's Church, inside of which she lives. She is Rea Himuro's caretaker, and acts as a motherly figure to her, and seems to have a past with Father Trifa.

Despite what her extremely kind, and even teasing and playful, disposition would suggest, she's actually a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat XI of the Black Round Table and answering to the Demon Name of Babylon Magdalena: Great Mother.

cast.characterName: ウォルフガング・シュライバー
cast.originalCharacterName: ウォルフガング・シュライバー

segments.text: Wolfgang Schreiber was a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat XII in the Black Round Table. Beginning as a mere street prostitute and serial killer in the streets of Berlin around the era World War II began, Schreiber would go on to become part of the Three Knights, the first members of the Round Table that would be granted the honor of becoming Einherjar in service to Reinhard Heydrich, as the upper echelons of the Longinus Thirteen and essential pieces in completing the plans of the Golden Beast.

An ominous magician and alchemist who created Ewigkeit and established the Obsidian Round Table. He was the one responsible for turning the LDO from a clique of elite army officers merely dabbling in the occult into a den of genuine demons. Not only is Mercurius the one sworn friend of the Table's leader, he also stands as the only being capable of matching his sublime prowess.

Although his position could be considered that of a mentor and a father, the other LDO members - with the exception of their master - shun him as a hateful taboo. His whereabouts have remained a mystery for the past six decades.
"Let the curtains rise on tonight's Grand Guignol."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

cast.characterName: ベアトリス・ヴァルトルート・フォン・キルヒアイゼン
cast.originalCharacterName: ベアトリス・ヴァルトルート・フォン・キルヒアイゼン

segments.text: Beatrice Waltrud von Kircheisen was a former member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, being Kei Sakurai's predecessor in Seat V of the Black Round Table, now deceased. Despite being dead as of the beginning of Dies Irae's main story, her influence is still felt, mainly thanks to her connection to Kai and Kei Sakurai, as well as to her former commanding officer.

The head of the Kendo Club. Unyielding and masculine, she and Ren share a rather masochistic relationship. Unlike the infamous Ren, Kasumi is cheerful and sociable, her fame further amplified by her national-level fencing skills. She has a generally rough personality, but when it comes to Ren, she's prone to worrying and being fussy. She has a tendency to try and act the older sister from time to time, but she neither looks, nor feels the part.
"You always make that face when you're hiding something from me."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

A mysterious girl who appears in Ren's dreams. She is clearly not Japanese, but her background and true name are unknown. For all we know, she might be just a figment of the young man's imagination. A maiden of the twilight, she sings a loathed refrain with a pure, angelic smile. Could that scar across her neck have been left by a guillotine?
"I shall hate and love you."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

Ren's best friend since childhood. He is a genius skilled in all sorts of fields, but as a result, he finds life boring. As a constant thrill-seeker, he acts recklessly and even incited a brutal fight with Ren, ultimately breaking off their friendship. As a result, he vanished from school and has not been heard from since.
"Men that keep yapping on about shit at the sidelines while women do all the fighting can go to hell."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

segments.text: Erii Honjou is the girlfriend of Shirou Yusa. She is the daughter of a well off family, with her grandfather owning a well known hospital. While by day, she was an honors student at a prestigious school, she secretly moonlights as a rebellious hacker.
Isaak is the illegitimate son of Reinhard Heydrich and Riza Brenner, as well as the grandfather of Rea. He controls Reinhard's castle.
Kai Sakurai was Kei Sakurai's older brother, and a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden until his death. After dying, he became part of the gestalt undead known as Tubal Cain.
Kirisaki Kyouka was a student at Tsukinosawa High and a secret member of Doppeladdler.
Jane Doe is a member of Doppeladdler.

segments.text: Siegelinde Eberwein is the leader of Doppeladdler.

"This person had a body abnormality: a third eye. Because he was different from the normal, he was abhorred. He was sold for a dirt cheap price to reduce the number of mouths. At that time, there was a rite called "Sokushinbutsu" where a monk would depart from one's life while meditating and become a shintai as a saint mummy. And so that person was dedicated to that rite. Of course, not out of free will. He was only a very young child who could not resist. It was convenient for his buyers. If one takes a different view, his grotesque appearance was adorning, and therefore it was something to celebrate. No one noticed the truth, hidden inside.

He was dropped into a hole. A five-story shrine was built on top of it. That person was buried in the darkness with no one to contact him, with no chance to escape, with no light to touch him. There have been many days, months, and years since he was there... I don't know what sort of law (god) his buyers wished for. However, I can guess their intentions. To create a craving for the outside world. To evocate a curse of grieving to the extent of madness. To establish a hegemony with a heretic law similar to Kodoku or Inugami. And, finally, to repaint all the Twilight's creation.

It should be said that it was so foolish. Why, you ask? Because they misread the true nature of that person. Hajun (me) loved exactly that avidya (silence). The universe, that is complete only by his (mine) existence! Ah, exactly for that reason, I hate you, bastards, who never leave Hajun (me) alone! Therefore, I will find you all. I will undoubtedly crush all of nature!
'Tis is the general principle of the sixth generation, Sinza of the sixth generation!..
'Tis is all the truth of the Sixth Heaven, Hajun!"
Story of Hajun from Nakanoin Reizen.
Translated from in-game narration

He is born with the sin of pride and as the counter of Muzan. As he recognizes that he has sin, he is trembling in rage and promise to overthrow him no matter what. He is the real vessel from one of 7 Maou. His intelligence is not enough to described as genius, he reproduction and proof that what is written in scripture is real. He creates angel, demon and human from zero. He creates "formula" to access and intervene the world be it was different dimension, different timeline or even the god throne. After he left his vessel that contain the sin of pride, at that time he have reach the god throne and his world "Tzwal" is manifested.

cast.originalCharacterName: ロートス・ライヒハート

segments.text: Lotus Reichhart was a Nazi soldier and best friend of Michael Wittman.

Mitra Paramatman also known as The Ātman (真我, Shinga lit True Self), is the First God to hold the throne and planned all its succeeding eras in order to create a powerful army strong enough to fight against Naraka. She is also Varuna's former lover.

Magsarion is a heretical warrior of Yazata, who walk on the path of Madou, and could be recognized by his exterior personality as The Remorseless. The second Hegemony God to sit on the Throne as well as the creator of the world of Paradise Lost.
Affiliation: Unknown

A mysterious young woman who is the self-proclaimed older sister to a young boy. A character who holds tons of secrets. However, make no mistake, to her there is nothing more precious than her younger brother.
Edited from Dies irae Pantheon's character page
Affiliation: Seventh Divine Throne/Shokou Mandala

The one who controls the Seventh-generation Divine Throne, the current god. Though her origin itself is rather peculiar, something she herself is not aware of. She was once overwhelmed by boredom, however when she discovered the protagonist that boredom turned into glee and joy. Because of her ignorance of the ways of the world, she’s somewhat selfish. However, at her core she is a naive girl.
She is the daughter of Habaki and Rindo from Six Heroes that defeat Hajun.
Translated from Dies irae Pantheon's character page
Affiliation: Seventh Divine Throne/Shokou Mandala

A young woman who serves as Hirume's aide. Due to her straight-laced nature, she puts too much focus in her role as a retainer, and is faced with the dilemma of not living up to the expectations as the friend and sisterly figure Hirume wished for in their relationship. For that reason, the protagonist's existence is Yomi's one saving grace. She nervously tries to build a new relationship with the boy.
Translated from Dies irae Pantheon's character page
